description: Look up how Jobsite (this product) works — features, UI navigation, terminology, account / billing, worker-side experience, what counts as a 'group' vs 'crew', etc. Use this for any 'how do I…' / 'where do I find…' / 'what does X mean in Jobsite' question. Returns matching sections from the curated product guide. NOT for OSHA / regulatory questions (use search_law_corpus or search_training_source) and NOT for tenant data lookups (use list_workers, list_expiring_certs, etc.). If a returned section is flagged todo:true, the topic is in scope but not yet documented — say so rather than inventing an answer.

limit.description: Max sections to return. Defaults to 4, cap 8.

query.description: Natural-language query, e.g. 'how do I add a worker', 'difference between groups and crews', 'where do I see expiring certs'.

name: lookup_jobsite_docs
title: Search the Jobsite product guide
